premises.text: Checkpoints is a marketing company that introduces consumers to products using mobile technology.
premises.evidence_span: Checkpoints is also a marketing company that introduces consumers to products. But this time, instead of using search, we're using mobile.

premises.text: Consumers can earn rewards in over one million stores throughout the U.S. with just their iPhone.
premises.evidence_span: upon launch, consumers can earn rewards in over one million stores throughout the U.S. with just their iPhone.

premises.text: Advertisers can reach consumers in-store with targeted marketing messages.
premises.evidence_span: they can reach consumers of the demographic they're looking for in any store in America where their product is sold.

premises.text: The app allows consumers to scan products to earn points and unlock interactive content.
premises.evidence_span: In order to scan a product and earn points, they just tap on the particular product that they're looking for, pick up their phone, put it over the UPC code, and it's that simple.

premises.text: Consumers can redeem points for rewards from various partners.
premises.evidence_span: we have over 40 partnerships in the rewards area that the user can redeem for.

value.text: Consumers receive rewards and interactive content while shopping.
value.evidence_span: providing a fun and rewarding opportunity for consumers to get just a little bit of extra value.

notes: Launch partners mentioned are excluded as traction.
